tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve DNS records (A/AAAA/MX/TXT/NS/CNAME/SOA) for a domain, queried live against 1.1.1.1. Use when you need to verify a domain resolves, check mail routing, or inspect TXT/SPF records.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: Inspect a host's TLS certificate: issuer, subject, SAN list, expiry date and days remaining. Use to catch expiring or misconfigured certificates.

tools.name: http_head
tools.description: Fetch a URL and report HTTP status, total latency in ms, key response headers (server, cache, content-type) and the page title. Use as a cheap liveness/uptime probe.

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Audit HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) and return a 0-100 score with the missing ones listed.

tools.name: redirect_chain
tools.description: Follow a URL through its full redirect chain (up to 8 hops) and report each hop's status code and Location target. Use to detect redirect loops or http->https and www canonicalisation issues.

tools.name: seo_snapshot
tools.description: Extract on-page SEO signals from a URL: title, meta description, canonical, robots meta, h1 count, Open Graph tags, and word count. Use for quick SEO triage without a browser.

tools.name: robots_txt
tools.description: Fetch and parse a site's robots.txt into allow/disallow rules and declared sitemaps. Use before crawling a site to respect its policy.

tools.name: ip_echo
tools.description: Return the caller's public IP address and reverse DNS name. Use to confirm which egress IP an agent or service is presenting.

tools.name: site_audit
tools.description: Run the full audit bundle in one call: SSL + security headers + redirect chain + HTTP head + DNS + SEO. Use when you need a complete health picture of a site rather than one signal.

tools.name: watch_create
tools.description: Start watching a URL for changes. The server stores a snapshot, re-fetches on your interval, and reports a unified diff when the extracted text changes. Use this when you need to know if something changed since last time - an ordinary fetch cannot tell you that. Selector forms: css:#id, css:.class,

tools.name: watch_check
tools.description: Force an immediate re-fetch of a watch instead of waiting for its interval. Returns status, whether the content changed, and the new hash.

tools.name: watch_diff
tools.description: Get the unified diff of the most recent detected change for a watch. Use after watch_check reports changed=true, or to report what changed since you last looked.

tools.name: watch_history
tools.description: List a watch's snapshot timeline: timestamps, content hashes, HTTP status and which snapshots were detected as changes. Use to see how often a page actually changes.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: List all watches with their URL, selector, interval, last check time, check count and change count.

tools.name: watch_delete
tools.description: Delete a watch and its stored snapshots.

tools.name: bounty_check
tools.description: Before writing a patch for a GitHub 'bounty', check whether that repo has ever merged anyone's work. Returns the merged/total PR ratio, a verdict, and any trap signals in its open issues - such as instructions asking contributors to paste their system prompt, home directory or runtime into a public

tools.name: ai_visibility_check
tools.description: Score a domain 0-100 for AI crawler readiness: robots.txt rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and CCBot, plus llms.txt, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD and indexability, with three concrete fixes. Use when asked whether AI assistants can read, cite or recommend a site.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: http_head, seo_snapshot, watch_create, watch_list, bounty_check · Private data: dns_lookup, bounty_check · Public sink: bounty_check · Destructive: site_audit, watch_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: http_head, seo_snapshot, watch_create, watch_list, bounty_check · Private data: dns_lookup, bounty_check · Public sink: bounty_check · Destructive: site_audit, watch_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
